versions.changelog:
Initial release of knowledge-base-health-check skill:

- Compares FAQ knowledge base with gold-tier customer service dialogue records to identify inconsistencies, outdated content, and missing entries.
- Generates two Markdown reports: a detailed difference report and a prioritized list of optimization suggestions.
- Supports multiple file formats (xlsx, xls, md, txt, csv) for input and utilizes a dedicated script for standardized file reading.
- Designed to help teams regularly audit and update FAQ content based on real customer interactions.
- Ensures results are evidence-based, objective, and sensitive to data privacy considerations.
